package def

//roost:dao coll=alliances db=game dbscope=global
type AllianceDao struct {
	Name     string            `remoteview:"public,member" store:"name"`
	Level    int32             `remoteview:"public,member" store:"level"`
	Bonus    int64             `remoteview:"member" store:"bonus"`
	Treasury int64             `store:"treasury"`
	Tags     []string          `remoteview:"public" store:"tags"`
	Members  map[int64]*Member `remoteview:"member" store:"members"`
	Profile  *Member           `remoteview:"member" store:"profile"`
	Blobs    map[string][]byte `remoteview:"member" store:"blobs"`
}
type Member struct {
	Name      string           `store:"name"`
	Scores    []int64          `store:"scores"`
	Buffs     map[string]int64 `store:"buffs"`
	Transient string           `dao:"nopersist,nosync" store:"transient"`
}
